meta.title: DPD assemblies — billed rank, emission, interval
meta.window_note: Rolling ~24 months from latest billing date. DPD ASM / DPF ASM only.
meta.emission_rule: D-Max Europe/Israel: model year ≤2015 Euro 5, 2016–2020 Euro 6, 2021+ Euro 6d. N-series Europe 2014+ treated as Euro 6 when the EPC string has no token. Billed mix uses who bought the PN: EU/UK/Israel vs CIS.
meta.interval_rule: Observed rate = DPD ASM pcs in the window ÷ years ÷ trucks in service 2024 of the billed segment, shown per 1,000 vehicles. Destock and old fleet move this number — it is not an IML service interval.

hero.capture_one_liner: There is no IML service interval for DPD assemblies, and they are not in the PMS capture list. The per-distributor year figure on this page is observed billed pieces versus trucks in service — not a scheduled interval and not a capture %.
